correctness.rationale: The 3x3 row-generator determinant is z[z²+(a+b+c+h)z+ab+bc+ca+ch], with discriminant (h-c+a+b)²-4ab. Its sign proves the exact two-root oscillatory interval and all boundary cases. Stationary global balance yields pi=(c(b+h),ac,ab)/[c(b+h)+ac+ab], hence J=abc/[c(b+h)+ac+ab] is strictly decreasing. At either exceptional point, diagonalizability would imply Q=lambda(I-1pi), contradicting Q_02=0 with pi2>0. The derivative of rho² has sign of h_*-h and establishes the unique optimum when oscillations exist. For a state-0 start, nonzero initial projection implies infinitely many stationary-level crossings exactly in the complex regime. A standalone executable first verified exact algebraic identities and then passed 2,200 eigensystem, 2,200 stationary, 2,200 current, 900 optimization, 600 exceptional-rank, and 900 matrix exponential tests. These finite checks supplement, not replace, the universal proof.

value.rationale: The contrast between strictly decreasing steady cycle current and newly induced damped transient oscillations provides a physically motivated structural effect not visible in the stationary current alone. The entire parameter phase diagram states when oscillations cannot occur, occur at baseline, or occur only in an interior reverse-rate window. The genuine double-mode exceptional boundaries and unique globally coherence-maximizing reverse rate make the result an exact, interpretable control design fact; no large-network or experimental performance theorem is assumed.
